baseline.reuse: Existing accepted83 static input hashes; no F703/F704/BZ78/BZ79 audit replay.

proposal.root_frozen_manifest: ROOT delegated frozen path/SHA packet in this lease

review_scope: Static only budget-denial witness capture and runner saved-result transfer. Summary/UI belongs ANALYTICS. Controlled fixtures only; no actual receipts/counters/auth/CF proofs in this package.

checks.requirement: Exact proposal path/hash matches ROOT freeze; baseline budget/runner retained. Review diff only; distinguish STATIC_REVIEW from ROOT connected qualification.

Existing comparisons, operators, cost values, sum order, first-deny order, provider iteration and detail/reason remain unchanged. No catch converting existing errors or extra diagnostic failure replacing a decision.
checks.evidence: Diff of assess paths/call sites including early invalid-cost/global/plan/provider returns

checks.requirement: Capture the same already evaluated terms from the same assess state and cached now used by its global/plan/future/provider forecasts. No independent clock(), Date.now(), state reread or recomputation to obtain another-time witness; preserve existing provider-policy admission clock calls.
Do not evaluate later branch work solely for a witness: an earlier global denial must not call automaticPlan/candidatePacing/providerPolicy/quote hooks that previously would not run.
checks.evidence: Control-flow comparison at every first-deny point

checks.requirement: Witness uses the exact C for the evaluated pass: base allocation vs owned NEW quote operation distinguished. Keep quote verify/commit ownership checks, their call count/order, existing/exhausted/surplus entry conditions and idempotency unchanged.

No changes to reserve/finalize/closeCandidate, charged counters, residual holds, grant states, future reservations, manual reserve or caps. No automatic refund, removal, repricing or new source route.
checks.evidence: Unchanged mutation spans and resource-state parity acceptance criterion

checks.requirement: Bounded output has explicit fixed schema, field/term/provider/string limits; only primitive derived terms and enum identifiers needed for explanation. Never clone/serialize whole resource state, credentials, raw source bodies or private records.
checks.evidence: Diagnostic helper allowlist, size bound, optional-field validation

checks.requirement: Diagnostic formatting is pure and total for call-site inputs; invalid/missing/nonfinite terms must not introduce a throw, allow or refusal into the old decision path. No mutable references to saved state or witness-driven policy changes.
checks.evidence: Helper code and caller contracts, invalid-shape controlled fixture requirements

checks.requirement: No extra HTTP, SQL query, store get/atomic/set, native stage or source/provider/admission call. Use the existing result-save call only. Additional serialized bytes must be explicitly bounded; zero new calls does not prove byte-identical CPU/storage/physical cost.
checks.evidence: Import/call graph and existing runner-save transfer

checks.requirement: runner carries diagnostic only for the already denied result; preserves status/source_coverage.reason/detail/delivery and does not mark it checked, ready or sent. No extra save or execution.
checks.evidence: Focused runner diff and return shape

checks.requirement: ROOT ONE new connected controlled case should compare old/new decisions and resource state, quote-hook call order/count, clock sequence and IO counts; permitted result difference is bounded witness only. Include earlier/later denial boundaries, new/existing quote, invalid terms and runner saved transfer.
checks.evidence: Qualification requirement only: SOURCES no Node/import/tests and no PASS claim for unexecuted case

checks.requirement: No live acceptance or current-state inference from controlled fixtures. Live83 settings/caps/manual reserve/strategy and paused work untouched; actual-data restriction maintained.

cutoff_policy: If frozen code not received before work cutoff, preserve this checklist as PENDING with no invented PASS and release own lease in time.
